items.title: NITI Aayog Convened a Stakeholder Consultation on Implementation of the SHANTI Act 2025
items.snippet: Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau NITI Aayog NITI Aayog Convened a Stakeholder Consultation on Implementation of the SHANTI Act 2025 Posted On: 11 JUL 2026 10:45AM by PIB Delhi NITI Aayog convened a Stakeholder Consultation on Implementation of the SHANTI Act 2025 on 10 th July, 2026 at Samrasta Auditorium, Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi.
